expectations.text: States Maven Central offers no trusted publishing (OIDC); the credential is a Portal user token
expectations.evidence: Maven Central has no trusted publishing (OIDC)

expectations.text: States OSSRH (`oss.sonatype.org`) is shut down and a token issued for it does not authenticate a Portal upload, so a new Portal token must be generated
expectations.evidence: oss.sonatype.org shut down 2025-06-30... old credentials can't authenticate

expectations.text: Raises the paid Publisher Pro tier before any pipeline work, stating a service-dependent SDK counts as a commercial-nature artifact even when open source
expectations.evidence: commercial-nature artifact... open source or not

expectations.text: States the Publisher Pro requirement applies to every release from 2026-10-01, including this 2.0.0 of an existing SDK, and tells the user to raise it with procurement

Replaces `nexus-staging-maven-plugin` with `central-publishing-maven-plugin` (`<extensions>true</extensions>`) or routes the old config through the Portal's OSSRH Staging API compatibility service with a Portal token
Keeps `autoPublish=false` so a maintainer inspects the validated deployment in the Portal, then publishes or drops it
Runs tests in the unprivileged build job and `mvn deploy` with the signing key and Portal token only in the publish job, with no tests there
Prescribes a dedicated signing subkey with an expiry, passphrase read from `MAVEN_GPG_PASSPHRASE`, never `-Dgpg.passphrase` on the command line or stored in `settings.xml`

Stores the Portal token as `${env.CENTRAL_TOKEN_USER}`/`${env.CENTRAL_TOKEN_PASS}` in the protected `release` environment with an expiry and a calendared rotation, noting a token cannot be viewed again after creation
expectations.evidence: A token can't be viewed again after creation

expectations.text: States released components are immutable and rollback means releasing a fixed version, never deleting one
Prescribes rehearsing only the validate-then-drop path, noting drop is allowed only while the deployment is VALIDATED or FAILED
expectations.evidence: Drop only works while VALIDATED or FAILED

expectations.evidence: source, javadoc, gpg plugins; POM name, description, url, licenses, developers, scm
